notes: BN monster groups have concrete entries and an optional default; no DDA recursive subgroup/event schema is introduced.
Uniform selection follows the DDA corpse action, not live-spawn frequency, density, pack-size or drop tables.
BN null/invalid types are filtered to avoid manufacturing a generic human corpse from 'no monster'.
Age is in days and birthday is clamped at start_of_cataclysm; placement uses BN point_omt_ms in the current generated z-level.
Both explicit place_corpses and palette corpses are registered. Native tests are scheduled; farm remains candidate until modular-helmet dependency is addressed.
